part1_item1.notes:
[chunk 2/2] Key findings from MSFT 10-Q (Q3 FY2026, filed 2026-04-29):

1. UNCOMMENCED DATACENTER LEASES ($196.6B) — The single most material off-balance-sheet item. Microsoft has signed but not yet commenced leases totaling $196.6B, primarily for datacenters, commencing FY2026–FY2031 with terms up to 21 years. This is a massive future liability pipeline not yet reflected in the balance sheet. Severity 4 (critical).

2. FINANCE LEASE SURGE — On-balance-sheet finance lease liabilities grew 36% in 9 months ($46.2B → $62.9B). New finance lease ROU assets obtained in 9mo FY2026 = $19.5B vs $14.0B in prior year period. Total gross property under finance leases = $77.6B. Finance lease cost (amortization + interest) was $5.7B for 9 months.

3. OPENAI RECAPITALIZATION — The OpenAI Recapitalization event is explicitly referenced as causing a "dilution gain" that triggered deferred tax expense in MSFT's effective tax rate for 9mo FY2026. This signals a material change in MSFT's equity stake/economics in OpenAI. No dollar amount disclosed for the gain itself in this section.

4. IRS NOPA — IRS seeking $28.9B additional tax + penalties for TY2004–2013 (transfer pricing). Unrecognized tax benefits = $29.3B at Mar-26.

5. RPO = $633B — Remaining performance obligations of $633B (commercial: $627B) at Mar-26, weighted avg ~2.5 years. This is the revenue backstop against which the datacenter capex pipeline must be judged.

6. No individual customer >10% of revenue. No specific counterparty named for datacenter lease obligations in this section.
